test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Comprehension: Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V live on seven different floors of a building. The lowermost floor is 1 and the topmost is 7. P does not live on the topmost floor. Q lives immediately below U. R lives on an even-numbered floor. Three people live between U and R. The number of people living between U and S is equal to the number of people living between S and R. More than four people live between T and V. Q lives on one of the floors below V.

Question: Who among the following lives two floors below P?
solution:
Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V live on seven different floors of a building. 

1. P does not live on the topmost floor.

2. More than four people live between T and V. Q lives on one of the floors below V. 

3. Q lives immediately below U.

3.Three people live between U and R. 

4. R lives on an even-numbered floor.

5. The number of people living between U and S is equal to the number of people living between S and R.

T lives two floors below P.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 3**”.
